initial_prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE polished entire-screen concept image for the Vietnamese idle racing game daily reward popup. Portrait canvas approximately 886x1920 (390x845 logical aspect). Straight-on flat screenshot, no phone frame, no perspective. Input reference image is STYLE REFERENCE: preserve warm cream/beige Soft Miniature UI, glossy colorful miniature 3D reward icons, cyan gift header, orange claim button. Redesign layout as CONCEPT 2: ICON LEFT, NUMBER RIGHT.
Fit the complete popup on screen with small margins, rounded warm ivory panel, soft rims and subtle shadows. Bold readable Vietnamese rounded sans-serif typography, dark navy text. Header cyan with glossy red/gold gift at left, exact title "QUÀ HẰNG NGÀY", red rounded close button "X" at right. Below exact centered line "Đăng nhập mỗi ngày, nhận quà cực chất!" then small blue pill "Đã nhận: 0 ngày".
Six EQUAL SIZE wide rounded cards in 2 columns x 3 rows, packed neatly with modest gaps. Each card has "Ngày N" along top, large glossy icon LEFT in its body and LARGE BOLD NUMBER RIGHT. Center icon vertically in body; balanced composition. Card text only its day label and bare quantity, plus status label below for today. No reward names written anywhere inside daily cards. Day 1: "Ngày 1", blue Pro racing ticket icon as in reference, number "2", highlighted golden yellow border and cream yellow fill, small attached bottom label "HÔM NAY". Day 2: "Ngày 2", silver-blue Standard ticket icon, number "2". Day 3: "Ngày 3", magenta faceted gem icon, number "15". Day 4: "Ngày 4", purple/gold All-Star ticket icon, number "1". Day 5: "Ngày 5", gold Elite ticket icon, number "1". Day 6: "Ngày 6", magenta gem icon, number "20". These six cards must all have identical dimensions, aligned left/right icon-number arrangement. Do not add any "Đã nhận" status because no days have been claimed.
Next full-width special day card, cyan with gold edge, title "NGÀY 7 · QUÀ ĐẶC BIỆT". Show glossy gift at left, then magenta gem with number "30", plus purple/gold All-Star ticket icon with number "2". Bare numbers beside icons, no reward names. Absolutely NO strip or text "Hoàn thành 7 ngày để nhận", leave it out entirely.
Below, compact accumulated rewards area heading "QUÀ TÍCH LŨY" and blue pill "0/10 ngày". Four aligned milestone columns connected by thin beige track with four unfilled round markers. Exact day labels: "Ngày 10", "Ngày 20", "Ngày 30", "Ngày 40". Day10 magenta gem icon and "40"; Day20 purple/gold All-Star ticket icon and "2"; Day30 magenta gem "80" plus ticket icon "2"; Day40 magenta gem and "40". Use icons and bare numbers; no reward names. Ensure all four milestones readable and fit evenly.
At bottom full-width large glossy orange rounded CTA with small gift icon and exact white bold text "NHẬN QUÀ". Keep all required elements visible without cropping. Optimize density to use portrait height efficiently with no excessive empty space. NO additional completion/progress message strip, no extraneous copy, no watermark, no developer annotations, no concept title. Vietnamese diacritics must be accurate. Distinguish ticket types visually through colors and emblem details without writing Pro/Standard/All-Star/Elite in cards.
